description: This file contains the FastAPI route definitions for user authentication, registration, and CRUD operations on notes. It defines API endpoints for registering a new user, authenticating to obtain JWT tokens, retrieving current user info, and managing notes (create, read, update, delete), with access control based on the current authenticated user.

methods.name: User get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on the JWT token.

methods.name: register(user: models.UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password.

methods.name: login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the details of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: create_note(note: models.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_notes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists notes belonging to the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note owned by the authenticated user.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note_update: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of a note owned by the user.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note owned by the user.
